headline: Oil Prices Recover Following U.S. Election Results
summary: Oil prices rose, recovering from previous losses following the Democratic victory in the U.S. elections. The market reacted to shifting political expectations regarding energy policy.
why: Oil prices are highly sensitive to U.S. political outcomes, which can influence domestic production, trade sanctions, and global supply chain dynamics.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Market adjustment to new political leadership and potential energy policy shifts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Markets often adjust to new political administrations by pricing in potential changes to energy regulations and trade relations.
